question_text: Name one power of the U.S. Congress.
lead_in: You only need to name one. Any of these works:

why_it_matters.text: Congress holds the most powerful tools in government: the power to write laws, declare war, and decide how every federal dollar gets spent. No president can declare war, spend money, or pass a law without Congress. That's why the founders made Congress first — and biggest — in the Constitution.

fun_fact.text: Congress hasn't formally declared war since 1942. Every U.S. conflict since — Korea, Vietnam, the Gulf War, Iraq, Afghanistan — used a different tool: 'authorization for use of military force.' Same effect, different name.
